meta.name: create-music-elevenlabs
meta.description: Generate an instrumental music bed via ElevenLabs Music, ROUTED THROUGH THE elevenlabs-proxy so it bills the Ads agent. Trims any sparse intro, loudnorm, fades the tail. Prompt + length from the template recipe. Use for the music layer of any video-ad format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频广告生成并处理背景音乐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频广告中快速添加符合模板的背景音乐
copy.tagline_en: Generate and process background music for video ads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly add template-based background music to video ads

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 ElevenLabs Music 生成一段纯音乐背景音，自动裁剪开头空白、标准化音量、淡出结尾。音乐时长和提示词由模板配方决定。
howto.when: 当需要为视频广告等格式制作背景音乐时触发。

say.text: 为这个15秒广告生成一段轻快的背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能生成音乐并处理音频。

say.text: 用模板配方生成一段时长10秒的钢琴背景音。
say.note: Claude 会根据提示词和时长生成音乐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an instrumental music bed via ElevenLabs Music, automatically trimming sparse intros, applying loudnorm, and fading the tail. Duration and prompt come from the template recipe.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a background music track is needed for video-ad formats or similar use cases.

say_en.text: Generate a light background music for this 15-second ad.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the skill to create and process the music.

say_en.text: Use the template recipe to generate a 10-second piano bed.
say_en.note: Claude will generate music based on the prompt and duration.
